_comment_about_this_file: Firefox managed-storage values for Sonomos Desktop Connector.
Drop into the path matching your platform — see the comment in
firefox-policies.json for the full path list. The file MUST be
named after the gecko id: desktop-connector@sonomos.ai.json
Firefox reads this file once at startup; restart the browser after
editing. Values land in browser.storage.managed and override the
name: desktop-connector@sonomos.ai
